definitions.title: The Integral Test
definitions.latex: \sum_{n=1}^\infty a_n \text{ and } \int_1^\infty f(x) dx \quad \text{both converge or both diverge}
definitions.statement: Let f(x) be a continuous, positive, decreasing function on [1, oo) such that a_n = f(n). Then the infinite series sum a_n converges if and only if the improper integral int_1^oo f(x) dx converges.
definitions.explanation: Bounds series sums between upper and lower Riemann integral areas.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Series convergence matches improper integral convergence for monotonic positive terms.

definitions.title: The p-Series Convergence Theorem
definitions.statement: The p-series converges if and only if p > 1. For p = 1, it yields the divergent Harmonic Series.
definitions.explanation: Direct consequence of the Integral Test evaluated on int 1/x^p dx.
